Delegation remains in effect until:

1. Reassigned by the Responsible Person to another individual.

2. Delegate departs the department or the University. The delegate must submit a DOA form to remove access.

3. Responsible Person changes due to reassignment or personnel changes (e.g., Division Head or Department Chair). A new DOA form must be submitted.
